She is the oldest of the four fairy sisters in {{BotW|-}}. Like the other Great Fairies, Tera will upgrade [[Link]]'s [[Armor]] in exchange for [[Material]]s.{{Cite|Why don't you show me the clothing you want to have enhanced? Depending on what {{Color BotW|Red|materials}} you have on hand, I should be able to {{Color BotW|Red|enhance your clothing}}. But it all depends!|Tera|BotW}} When Link first visits Tera's Great Fairy Fountain, it will be closed, and he will hear Tera asking him to listen to her story.{{Cite|{{Small|Boy...}} Sweet boy... Please... Listen to my story...|Tera|BotW}} If Link agrees, Tera introduces herself, explaining that her [[Great Fairy Fountain]] was once a spring, but it has dried up now that travelers no longer offer [[Rupee]]s to her. To restore her power, Tera requests that Link make an offering.{{Cite|I'm nearly powerless now, so I beg your help. I need rupees to become whole again.|Tera|BotW}} Depending on how many of Tera's sisters Link has already helped, she will ask for either 100 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|100 rupees}}...|Tera|BotW}} 500 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|500 rupees}}...|Tera|BotW}} 1,000 Rupees,{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|1,000 rupees}}...|Tera|BotW}} or 10,000 Rupees.{{Cite|All I need is {{Color BotW|Red|10,000 rupees}}...|Tera|BotW}} In return, she promises to use her power to help Link.{{Cite|Once my power has been restored, I can help you do great things, boy.|Tera|BotW}} Sticking her hand out of her Fountain, Tera then demands the Rupees from Link.{{Cite|Now... If you have rupees, hand them over to me. Quickly!|Tera|BotW}} Once Link pays her, Tera will thank him for his kindness.{{Cite|Thank you. You are too kind.|Tera|BotW}} The Great Fairy Fountain will then bloom as Tera's power is returned to her.{{Cite|Aah... The power... {{Big|It's overflowing!!!}}|Tera|BotW}} She will then emerge from the [[Water (Terrain)|Water]].{{Cite|{{Big|Ah-HAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!}}|Tera|BotW}} Clearing her throat, Tera introduces herself to Link as the eldest of the Great Fairies, admitting that she has witnessed his adventures from her Fountain. To prove that she can see all, Tera predicts that Link wants her to enhance his Armor.{{Cite|I'm not just making wild assumptions, you know! I truly do see all... I'll prove it right now! I'll...predict what you are thinking right at this very moment! ... ... You're probably thinking..."Can't we just skip to the part where she enhances my clothing..." Right? Looks like I hit the mark, hm? *ahem...* What an impatient person...|Tera|BotW}} She then asks to see the Armor that Link wants enhanced, revealing that she will need the proper Materials in order to do so. The degree to which Tera can enhance pieces of Armor depends on how many of her sisters have had their power restored.{{Cite|With the power available to me... I should be able to enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a little bit}}.|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|a fair amount}}.|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can {{Color BotW|Red|greatly}} enhance your clothing.|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|With the power available to me... I can enhance your clothing {{Color BotW|Red|to the max}}!|Tera|BotW}} If Link chooses to have Tera enhance his Armor, she will ask him to choose a piece from his [[Inventory]].{{Cite|Which clothing item would you like me to enhance?|Tera|BotW}} Following Tera's first enhancement, she informs Link that certain [[Armor Set]]s will receive a [[Set Bonus]] if they have been enhanced twice.{{Cite|Here...it's finished! Hmmm... You know, some sets—if you enhance each part of the set twice—will give you a special set bonus. Not every set, mind you! But some sets...|Tera|BotW}} Following their first meeting, Tera will loudly greet Link whenever he visits her Great Fairy Fountain.{{Cite|{{Big|Ba-baaaan!}}|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Dadada-daaaaaaa!}}|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Haaaaaai!}}|Tera|BotW}} On occasion, she will use a [[Gerudo (Language)|Gerudo]] greeting.{{Cite|{{Big|Sav'aaaaaaaq!}}|Tera|BotW}} Afterwards, Tera coughs, claiming it is due to swallowing Water or that she set a deep-diving record.{{Cite|{{Small|*cough...*}} Water... I inhaled a lot of water...|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Small|*cough...*}} I set a new deep-dive record!|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Small|*cough...cough*}} Guess... Guess that's it for my break...|Tera|BotW}} When Link ends his conversation with Tera, she states that she is returning to her home,{{Cite|Well then, I'm headed home!|Tera|BotW}} at which point she dives back into her Great Fairy Fountain.{{Cite|{{Big|We'll meet agaaain!}}|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Taaake caaare!}}|Tera|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Gooood-byyye!}}|Tera|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Checklist
